thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall: Org 'pyxis' (org_id=pyx-82) showing sustained QPS spike and elevated 502 errors. Error rate ~5% over the last 3m, tail latency increased. Auto-triage suggests temporary org-level RL override. Please ack and advise mitigation.

oncall-marta: Acked. I'm on call. pulling logs + quota view.

jamie: seeing a large burst from a small subset of keys, likely a new feature rollout at their side. 502s correlate with queued requests hitting model backend timeout.

ravi: can we apply a soft rate limit to pyx-82 and enable fallback model variant? That should reduce backend pressure quickly.

oncall-marta: Proposal: org rl = 0.6 req/s -> 0.2 req/s per token-stream for 15min, allow burst=5, and route to small-quant model when latency > 1s. Anyone object?

jamie: +1. Also enable prefix kv cache for that org if not already. That should cut token work.

support-alex: FYI customers in support queue reporting degraded experience; I'll update status page after mitigation.

ops-ryan: I can apply the RL via ops-admin CLI. command: ```ops-admin org-rate-update --org pyx-82 --rate 0.2 --burst 5 --duration 15m --reason "emergency qps spike"```

oncall-marta: Run it. I'll watch doorman and model metrics.

ops-ryan: Ran it: ```{"status":"ok","org":"pyx-82","new_rate":"0.2 r/s","burst":5,"expires_at":"3141593710"}``` :white_check_mark:

jamie: Seeing immediate drop in inflight and fewer 502s. tail latency down ~40%. Good signal.

oncall-marta: Also flipped fallback routing to small-quant for that org. Applied feature-flag: ```ff toggle pyx-82 route_to_small_quant true```

ravi: Great. Can we also pin their model to v1.12-quant for the window so backend isn't triggering costly kernel selection?

ops-ryan: Done: ```model-pin set --org pyx-82 --model rdx-small-v1.12-quant --until 3141593710```

support-alex: Updating customer comms: "We've applied a temporary safety throttle and routing changes to stabilize service. Expect improved latency within a few mins."

oncall-marta: Monitoring: error rate moving toward baseline. Will leave RL in place for 15m then gradually relax if stable. If we see repeat spikes re-open.

jamie: After window, recommend a post-incident note: root cause likely internal rollout; ask Pyxis to rollback feature or limit their client-side parallelism.

incident-bot: Incident note created: INC-20260324-pyx-82-rl-temporary. Pager duty followups assigned to jamie and oncall-marta.

support-alex: I'll file a customer postmortem template and include timings + commands used.

oncall-marta: Unassigning from page in 10m if metrics stay green. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

ops-ryan: Leaving logs & commands in the incident board: https://internal.redwood/incidents/INC-20260324-pyx-82

jamie: closing loop: no further action from infra, handoff to SRE for followup.

oncall-marta: Last check: 502s down to 0.8% and QPS back to normal range. demoting to monitoring-only at 3141592810.
